claim_boundary: DIRAC-009 is the highest passed research gate. Lean proves the complete positive two-field action and reciprocal variations, its centered reversible update and lossless first-order readout, and an exact nondegenerate surrounding-cell Bloch reduction of the native incidence residual to three equal-square mutually anticommuting cubical directions. Both native rank-four flavor copies are retained. The period-two cancellation is explicitly excluded as transport evidence. A 4x4x4 C19 full-action ensemble with active incidence energy passes 100 cycles at 64, 128 and 256 updates per cycle. Cube parity remains a geometric grading only; physical mass, the standard Dirac identification, the continuum theorem, current, spin and an electron remain open.
